correctness.rationale: For the 5-regular (not complementary 10-regular) Clebsch graph on even-weight five-bit words, all disconnected triples number 400, so cut facets are 400 complements of triples. Inspected complete 65199-face construction and scripted 32590-pair acyclic matching with all 519776 Hasse incidences, yielding critical cells one vertex, sixteen 11-cells and one 12-cell. The exact signed Morse projection code (read explicitly, not just its success line) computes boundary D=(0,0,2,-2,-2,2,-2,0,0,0,0,-2,-2,0,-2,0); gcd=2. As the resulting CW 11-skeleton is wedge16 S11, Hurewicz π11 is Z16 and an integral basis change sends the attaching map to twice one generator, giving 15 S11 ∨ M(Z/2,11). Independently regenerated dual small complex has (16,120,160,40) simplex counts and boundary ranks 15,104,40 over F2 versus 15,105,40 over F3, consistent with torsion. Finite-field ranks do not by themselves establish integral Moore attaching map.
residual_risks: Full 519776-incidence acyclicity and signed gradient-path enumeration inspected in original Python but not independently rerun; independent dual mod-field checks only corroborate.
